versos.grego: τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων ὄρθρου βαθέως ἐπὶ τὸ μνῆμα ἦλθον φέρουσαι ἃ ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα.

controles.web: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
controles.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
controles.livre: E no primeiro dia da semana, de madrugada bem cedo, foram ao sepulcro, levando consigo os materiais aromáticos que tinham preparado; e algumas outras junto delas.

versos.grego: εὗρον δὲ τὸν λίθον ἀποκεκυλισμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου,

controles.web: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
controles.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
controles.livre: E acharam a pedra já revolvida do sepulcro.

versos.grego: εἰσελθοῦσαι δὲ οὐχ εὗρον τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
controles.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: E entrando, não acharam o corpo do Senhor Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀπορεῖσθαι αὐτὰς περὶ τούτου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο ἐπέστησαν αὐταῖς ἐν ἐσθῆτι ἀστραπτούσῃ·

controles.web: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que estando elas perplexas, eis que dois homens apareceram junto a elas, com roupas luminosas.

versos.grego: ἐμφόβων δὲ γενομένων αὐτῶν καὶ κλινουσῶν τὰ πρόσωπα εἰς τὴν γῆν, εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτάς Τί ζητεῖτε τὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τῶν νεκρῶν;

controles.web: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth.   They said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
controles.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
controles.livre: E estando elas com muito medo, e abaixando o rosto para o chão, eles lhes disseram: Por que buscam entre os mortos aquele que vive?

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε, ἀλλὰ ἠγέρθη. μνήσθητε ὡς ἐλάλησεν ὑμῖν ἔτι ὢν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ,

controles.web: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
controles.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
controles.livre: Ele não está aqui, mas já ressuscitou. Lembrai-vos de como ele vos falou, quando ainda estava na Galileia,

versos.grego: λέγων τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὅτι δεῖ παραδοθῆναι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ σταυρωθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀναστῆναι.

controles.web: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
controles.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
controles.livre: Dizendo: É necessário que o Filho do homem seja entregue nas mãos de homens pecadores, e que seja crucificado, e ressuscite ao terceiro dia.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν τῶν ῥημάτων αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: They remembered his words,
controles.kjv: And they remembered his words,
controles.livre: E se lembraram das palavras dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑποστρέψασαι ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπήγγειλαν ταῦτα πάντα τοῖς ἕνδεκα καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς λοιποῖς.

controles.web: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
controles.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
controles.livre: E, voltando do sepulcro, anunciaram todas estas coisas aos onze, e a todos os outros.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δὲ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ Μαρία καὶ Ἰωάνα καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου· καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ σὺν αὐταῖς ἔλεγον πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ταῦτα.

controles.web: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
controles.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
controles.livre: E eram Maria Madalena, e Joana, e Maria mãe de Tiago, e as outras que estavam com elas, que diziam estas coisas aos apóstolos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐφάνησαν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λῆρος τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα, καὶ ἠπίστουν αὐταῖς.

controles.web: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
controles.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
controles.livre: E para eles, as palavras delas pareciam não ter sentido; e não creram nelas.

versos.grego: [[Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἀναστὰς ἔδραμεν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον· καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει τὰ ὀθόνια μόνα· καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὑτὸν θαυμάζων τὸ γεγονός.]]

controles.web: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
controles.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
controles.livre: Porém Pedro, levantando-se, correu ao sepulcro; e abaixando-se, viu os tecidos postos separadamente; e saiu maravilhado com o que tinha acontecido.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἦσαν πορευόμενοι εἰς κώμην ἀπέχουσαν σταδίους ἑξήκοντα ἀπὸ Ἱερουσαλήμ, ᾗ ὄνομα Ἐμμαοῦς,

controles.web: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
controles.livre: E eis que dois deles iam naquele mesmo dia a uma aldeia, cujo nome era Emaús, que estava a sessenta estádios de distância de Jerusalém.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡμίλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους περὶ πάντων τῶν συμβεβηκότων τούτων.

controles.web: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
controles.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
controles.livre: E iam falando entre si de todas aquelas coisas que tinham acontecido.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὁμιλεῖν αὐτοὺς καὶ συνζητεῖν, καὶ αὐτὸς Ἰησοῦς ἐγγίσας συνεπορεύετο αὐτοῖς·

controles.web: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles estavam conversando entre si, e perguntando um ao outro, Jesus se aproximou, e foi junto deles.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκρατοῦντο τοῦ μὴ ἐπιγνῶναι αὐτόν.

controles.web: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
controles.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
controles.livre: Mas seus olhos foram retidos, para que não o reconhecessem.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Τίνες οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι οὓς ἀντιβάλλετε πρὸς ἀλλήλους περιπατοῦντες; καὶ ἐστάθησαν σκυθρωποί.

controles.web: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Que conversas são essas, que vós discutis enquanto andam, e ficais tristes?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἷς ὀνόματι Κλεοπᾶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Σὺ μόνος παροικεῖς Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνως τὰ γενόμενα ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις;

controles.web: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
controles.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
controles.livre: E um deles ,cujo nome era Cleofas, respondendo-o, disse-lhe: És tu o único viajante em Jerusalém que não sabe as coisas que nela tem acontecido nestes dias?

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ποῖα; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τὰ περὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ, ὃς ἐγένετο ἀνὴρ προφήτης δυνατὸς ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ,

controles.web: He said to them, “What things?”   They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Quais?E eles lhe disseram: As sobre Jesus de Nazaré, a qual foi um homem profeta, poderoso em obras e em palavras, diante de Deus, e de todo o povo.

versos.grego: ὅπως τε παρέδωκαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν εἰς κρίμα θανάτου καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν.

controles.web: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
controles.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
controles.livre: E como os chefes dos sacerdotes, e nossos líderes o entregaram à condenação de morte, e o crucificaram.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἠλπίζομεν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων λυτροῦσθαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ· ἀλλά γε καὶ σὺν πᾶσιν τούτοις τρίτην ταύτην ἡμέραν ἄγει ἀφ’ οὗ ταῦτα ἐγένετο.

controles.web: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
controles.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
controles.livre: E nós esperávamos que ele fosse aquele que libertar a Israel; porém além de tudo isto, hoje é o terceiro dia desde que estas coisas aconteceram.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ καὶ γυναῖκές τινες ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξέστησαν ἡμᾶς, γενόμεναι ὀρθριναὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον,

controles.web: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
controles.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
controles.livre: Ainda que também algumas mulheres dentre nós nos deixaram surpresos, as quais de madrugada foram ao sepulcro;

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ εὑροῦσαι τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἦλθον λέγουσαι καὶ ὀπτασίαν ἀγγέλων ἑωρακέναι, οἳ λέγουσιν αὐτὸν ζῆν.

controles.web: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
controles.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
controles.livre: E não achando seu corpo, vieram, dizendo que também tinham visto uma aparição de anjos, que disseram que ele vive.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπῆλθόν τινες τῶν σὺν ἡμῖν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ εὗρον οὕτως καθὼς καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες εἶπον, αὐτὸν δὲ οὐκ εἶδον.

controles.web: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
controles.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
controles.livre: E alguns do que estão conosco foram ao sepulcro, e o acharam assim como as mulheres tinham dito; porém não o viram.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ὦ ἀνόητοι καὶ βραδεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ πιστεύειν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐλάλησαν οἱ προφῆται·

controles.web: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
controles.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Ó tolos, e que demoram no coração para crerem em tudo o que os profetas falaram!

versos.grego: οὐχὶ ταῦτα ἔδει παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
controles.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
controles.livre: Por acaso não era necessário que o Cristo sofresse estas coisas, e então entrar em sua glória?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν προφητῶν διερμήνευσεν αὐτοῖς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς γραφαῖς τὰ περὶ ἑαυτοῦ.

controles.web: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
controles.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
controles.livre: E começando de Moisés, e por todos os profetas, lhes declarava em todas as Escrituras o que estava escrito sobre ele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤγγισαν εἰς τὴν κώμην οὗ ἐπορεύοντο, καὶ αὐτὸς προσεποιήσατο πορρώτερον πορεύεσθαι.

controles.web: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
controles.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
controles.livre: E chegaram à aldeia para onde estavam indo; e ele agiu como se fosse para um lugar mais distante.

versos.grego: καὶ παρεβιάσαντο αὐτὸν λέγοντες Μεῖνον μεθ’ ἡμῶν, ὅτι πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἐστὶν καὶ κέκλικεν ἤδη ἡ ἡμέρα. καὶ εἰσῆλθεν τοῦ μεῖναι σὺν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.”   He went in to stay with them.
controles.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
controles.livre: E eles lhe rogaram, dizendo: Fica conosco, porque já é tarde, e o dia está entardecendo;E ele entrou para ficar com eles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κατακλιθῆναι αὐτὸν μετ’ αὐτῶν λαβὼν τὸν ἄρτον εὐλόγησεν καὶ κλάσας ἐπεδίδου αὐτοῖς·

controles.web: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, estando sentado com eles à mesa ,tomou o pão, o benzeu, o partiu, e o deu a eles.

versos.grego: αὐτῶν δὲ διηνοίχθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ, καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτόν· καὶ αὐτὸς ἄφαντος ἐγένετο ἀπ’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.
controles.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
controles.livre: E os olhos deles se abriram, e o reconheceram, e ele lhes desapareceu.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Οὐχὶ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν καιομένη ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν, ὡς ἐλάλει ἡμῖν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ὡς διήνοιγεν ἡμῖν τὰς γραφάς;

controles.web: They said one to another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
controles.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
controles.livre: E diziam um ao outro: Por acaso não estava nosso coração ardendo em nós, quando ele falava conosco pelo caminho, e quando nos desvendava as Escrituras?

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀναστάντες αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, καὶ εὗρον ἠθροισμένους τοὺς ἕνδεκα καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς,

controles.web: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
controles.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
controles.livre: E levantando-se na mesma hora, voltaram para Jerusalém, e acharam reunidos aos onze, e aos que estavam com eles,

versos.grego: λέγοντας ὅτι ὄντως ἠγέρθη ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὤφθη Σίμωνι.

controles.web: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
controles.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
controles.livre: Que diziam: Verdadeiramente o Senhor ressuscitou, e já apareceu a Simão.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐξηγοῦντο τὰ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὡς ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου.

controles.web: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
controles.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
controles.livre: E eles contaram as coisas que lhes aconteceram no caminho; e como foi reconhecido por eles quando partiu o pão.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτῶν λαλούντων αὐτὸς ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν [[καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν]].

controles.web: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
controles.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
controles.livre: E enquanto eles falavam disto, o próprio Jesus se pôs no meio deles, e lhes disse: Paz seja convosco.

versos.grego: πτοηθέντες δὲ καὶ ἔμφοβοι γενόμενοι ἐδόκουν πνεῦμα θεωρεῖν.

controles.web: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
controles.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
controles.livre: E eles, espantados, e muito atemorizados, pensavam que viam algum espírito.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί τεταραγμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ διὰ τί διαλογισμοὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν;

controles.web: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Por que estais perturbados, e por que sobem dúvidas em vossos corações?

versos.grego: ἴδετε τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου, ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι αὐτός· ψηλαφήσατέ με καὶ ἴδετε, ὅτι πνεῦμα σάρκα καὶ ὀστέα οὐκ ἔχει καθὼς ἐμὲ θεωρεῖτε ἔχοντα.

controles.web: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
controles.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
controles.livre: Vede minhas mãos, e os meus pés, que sou em mesmo. Tocai-me, e vede, porque um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, como vós vedes que eu tenho.

versos.grego: [[καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας.]]

controles.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
controles.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
controles.livre: E dizendo isto, lhes mostrou as mãos e os pés.

versos.grego: ἔτι δὲ ἀπιστούντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς καὶ θαυμαζόντων, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἔχετέ τι βρώσιμον ἐνθάδε;

controles.web: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
controles.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
controles.livre: E eles, não crendo ainda, por causa da alegria, e maravilhados, Jesus disse-lhes: Tendes aqui alguma coisa para comer?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐπέδωκαν αὐτῷ ἰχθύος ὀπτοῦ μέρος·

controles.web: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
controles.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
controles.livre: Então eles lhe apresentaram parte de um peixe assado.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβὼν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ἔφαγεν.

controles.web: He took them, and ate in front of them.
controles.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
controles.livre: Ele pegou, e comeu diante deles.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι μου οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔτι ὢν σὺν ὑμῖν, ὅτι δεῖ πληρωθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως καὶ τοῖς προφήταις καὶ ψαλμοῖς περὶ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: He said to them, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Estas são as palavras que eu vos disse, enquanto ainda estava convosco, que era necessário que se cumprissem todas as coisas que estão escritas sobre mim na Lei de Moisés, nos profetas, e nos Salmos.

versos.grego: τότε διήνοιξεν αὐτῶν τὸν νοῦν τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς γραφάς· καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς

controles.web: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
controles.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
controles.livre: Então ele lhes abriu o entendimento, para que entendessem as Escrituras.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὕτως γέγραπται παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ,

controles.web: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
controles.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Assim está escrito,  que o Cristo sofresse, e que ao terceiro dia ressuscitasse dos mortos;

versos.grego: καὶ κηρυχθῆναι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ μετάνοιαν εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη,— ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E que em seu nome fosse pregado arrependimento e perdão de pecados em todas as nações, começando de Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες τούτων.

controles.web: You are witnesses of these things.
controles.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.
controles.livre: E destas coisas vós sois testemunhas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πατρός μου ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς· ὑμεῖς δὲ καθίσατε ἐν τῇ πόλει ἕως οὗ ἐνδύσησθε ἐξ ὕψους δύναμιν.

controles.web: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
controles.livre: E eis que eu envio a promessa de meu Pai sobre vós; porém ficai vós na cidade de Jerusalém, até que vos seja dado poder do alto.

versos.grego: Ἐξήγαγεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἕως πρὸς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ἐπάρας τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
controles.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
controles.livre: E os levou para fora até Betânia, e levantando suas mãos, os abençoou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτοὺς διέστη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν [[καὶ ἀνεφέρετο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν]].

controles.web: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto os abençoava, ele se afastou deles, e foi conduzido para cima ao céu.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ [[προσκυνήσαντες αὐτὸν]] ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ μετὰ χαρᾶς μεγάλης,

controles.web: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
controles.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
controles.livre: E eles, adorando-o, voltaram para Jerusalém com grande alegria;

versos.grego: καὶ ἦσαν διὰ παντὸς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
controles.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
controles.livre: E estavam sempre no Templo, louvando e bendizendo a Deus. Amém.
